title: eros problem
description: The RFC 9457 problem body eros sends for an error. Its media type is application/problem+json.

type.description: about:blank, or <typeBase>/<code> when the application sets a typeBase.

title.description: The title of the error's kind, the same for every error of the kind.

status.description: The HTTP status of the error's kind.

detail.description: The error's message: what happened this time.

code.description: [<module>/<entity>/]<kind>[/<reason>], each segment in lower kebab case: orders/order/violation/already-paid. The contract a client branches on.

isRetryable.description: Whether the same request may succeed when it is sent again.

retryAfterSeconds.description: How long to wait before a retry, in whole seconds rounded up. Present only when the error sets it.

traceId.description: The trace of the request, when the application gives eros a way to read it.

errors.description: What failed validation, one item per failure.

then.description: An unexpected error is always masked.

else.description: Only an unexpected error has the kind internal.

pointer.description: The failed member, as an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer in URI fragment form: #/items/0/quantity.

code.description: What the member failed, in lower kebab case: invalid-format.
